pokedexEntries.go: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

pokedexEntries.si: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

pokedexEntries.cr: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predetermined for each SMEARGLE.

pokedexEntries.su: The unique creations produced by each Smeargle are painted using the fluid that oozes from its tail. This is how it marks its territory.

pokedexEntries.mo: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

pokedexEntries.us: The fluid of Smeargle’s tail secretions changes in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon’s emotions change.

pokedexEntries.um: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

pokedexEntries.sc: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.
